objective: Prove that every depth-d Frege refutation of the octahedral knot sphere's NAE formula has size exp(n^{eps_d}), by reducing the bit-encoded left pigeon principle to SINK, SINK to one-sided grid Sperner (COUNT-TFNP-20261107-001A) and grid Sperner to the sphere (FLAT-STATES-20261107-001B) with shallow decision trees, and the known bounded-depth Frege lower bounds for the pigeonhole principle.
status: Proved 2026-11-10: every depth-d Frege refutation of the sphere's NAE formula has size exp(n^{eps_d}), by the binary left-pigeon principle reducing to SINK (succ = f, pred = g), SINK to one-sided grid Sperner and grid Sperner to the sphere by decision trees of depth O(log N), and the bounded-depth Frege lower bounds for the bijective pigeonhole principle; known-with-delta.
title: The sphere's count needs exponential size in bounded-depth Frege
